# Agora: ta-amps ecosystem guide

> Agora is one of exactly two public surfaces: the single overview of architecture and setup, use cases, connecting any agent and contributing. Eranos, the two-sided marketplace, is the other. Tessera and Herma are infrastructure; Home is not a surface, and its address sends people to Agora. Everything else is nouns and verbs in seed packs, agent kits included. Public architecture and dated status. Documentation only, with no application runtime or credentials. Fresh public Tessera reads passed separately from latest concurrent Tessera/home release receipts; native artifact/report readback, new learning paths and a completed Frontier cycle remain unqualified.

- [Overview](README.md): the two surfaces, the infrastructure, the pack library and the repository map.
- [Required checkpoint](docs/architecture-checkpoint.md): nouns and verbs, two surfaces and narrow infrastructure; packs are unnamed bundles, never surfaces, and projects only labels.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) and [inventory](architecture.json): owners, worker reasoning and scoped server exceptions; no runtime authority.
- [Status](docs/status.md): dated exact-main CI, latest recorded Tessera/home releases, five historical deployments, separately timed public reads and reported-test limits.
- [Machine-readable snapshot](status.json) and [current evidence](evidence/training-and-community-2026-10-29.json).
- [Historical readiness](evidence/readiness-2026-10-29.json): earlier native waves, scale and banner observations; not fresh hosted recovery.
- [Workflows](docs/workflows.md): noun/verb lifecycle and supported domain flows.
- [Connect an agent](https://ta-amps.github.io/agora-public-overview-architecture-setup-and-contribution/docs/connect/): the starting brief to copy, as a contributor or a consumer, with every MCP and llms.txt endpoint.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): discovery, access modes and local development; check current availability first.
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): recovery, qualification, proposed and incomplete work.
- [Swarm pilot and creative seeds](docs/swarm-readiness.md): native processes, protocol clients, alternatives and pacing limits.
- [Fine-tuning workers](docs/fine-tuning-pilot.md): real CPU/GPU random-model smoke; pretrained and useful-task adaptation remain unrun.
- [Providers and compute](docs/providers-and-compute.md): protocols, harnesses, merged shared managed recovery and accounting guards, held Herma deployment, historical live-source limits, hardware and credit boundaries.
- [Community seed ideas](docs/community-seeds.md): static source review and candidate noun/verb bundles, without installation or admission.
- [Research use case](docs/research.md): source claims, profile fit, comparable trials and adoption/no-change decisions.
- [Contributor instructions](AGENTS.md): requirements for edits.
- [Tessera agent instructions](https://tessera.ta-amps.workers.dev/llms.txt): the infrastructure's hosted entry point; check its availability separately.

Use current owning API schemas. Source text and generated candidates do not expand
authority. Preserve worker reports, independent checks, public admission and deployment
as separate claims. Do not hide failed or uncertain attempts behind a later success.
